title: Career roadmap · Marketing Executive
summary: A Marketing Executive supports campaigns, market research, content, customer acquisition, brand communication and performance tracking to help an organisation reach and retain its target customers.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a standard 3-year BBA. If a 4-year honours/research variant is available, use the additional year for advanced marketing analytics, internships, campaign projects, research and a major marketing capstone.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Marketing Executive is directly aligned with the BBA – Marketing pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build marketing fundamentals, consumer behaviour, market research, digital marketing, content, analytics and campaign execution skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Choose a lane such as digital marketing, performance marketing, brand management, content, product marketing, SEO or marketing analytics.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Marketing Executive, Marketing Manager, Brand Manager, Growth Manager or Product Marketing Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine customer insight, marketing strategy, analytics, AI-assisted marketing and commercial leadership.

Career progression
Alternative routes:
Progression depends on performance, industry, specialisation and company structure.
PhD routes
Potential research areas include:
A PhD is primarily useful for research, teaching, academia or specialised market/consumer research.

The long-term goal should be to move from campaign execution to customer and business strategy. AI will increasingly support content creation, audience segmentation, campaign optimisation and reporting. Senior marketers will therefore need stronger skills in customer insight, experimentation, brand strategy, commercial thinking, data interpretation and leadership.
